memberdef.definition: typedef MonoMonoid<Exponent, true, false, false> SPairs::BareMonoid
memberdef.name: BareMonoid

detaileddescription.para: This monoid is used for computations to determine whether to eliminate an S-pair. These computations do not require anything beyond just considering the exponents. Since recomputing characteristics of lcms such as hash and degree is expensive (unlike for a product), it is worthwhile to disable those characteristics that we do not need.

memberdef.definition: typedef MonoMonoid<Exponent, true, false, true> SPairs::OrderMonoid
memberdef.name: OrderMonoid

detaileddescription.para: This monoid is used to order S-pairs by their lcm. Here we need to to store the ordering data for fast comparison, but we do not need hashes.
